entries.title: Matthew 3:1
segments: About that time John the Baptist first appeared, proclaiming in the Wilderness of Judea:

entries.title: Matthew 3:2
segments: "Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand."

entries.title: Matthew 3:3
segments: This is he who was spoken of in the Prophet Isaiah, where he says--'The voice of one crying aloud in the Wilderness: "Make ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight."'

entries.title: Matthew 3:4
segments: John wore clothing made of camels' hair, with a belt of leather round his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

entries.title: Matthew 3:5
segments: At that time Jerusalem, and all Judea, as well as the whole district of the Jordan, went out to him

entries.title: Matthew 3:6
segments: And were baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

entries.title: Matthew 3:7
segments: When, however, John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to receive his baptism, he said to them: "You brood of vipers! Who has prompted you to seek refuge from the coming judgement?

entries.title: Matthew 3:8
segments: Let your life, then, prove your repentance;

entries.title: Matthew 3:9
segments: And do not think that you can say among yourselves 'Abraham is our ancestor,' for I tell you that out of these very stones God is able to raise descendants for Abraham!

entries.title: Matthew 3:10
segments: Already the axe is lying at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that fails to bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

entries.title: Matthew 3:11
segments: I, indeed, baptize you with water to teach repentance; but He who is Coming after me is more powerful than I, and I am not fit even to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

entries.title: Matthew 3:12
segments: His winnowing-fan is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing-floor, and store his grain in the barn, but the chaff he will burn with inextinguishable fire."

entries.title: Matthew 3:13
segments: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

entries.title: Matthew 3:14
segments: But John tried to prevent him. "It is I," he said, "who need to be baptized by you; why then do you come to me?"

entries.title: Matthew 3:15
segments: "Let it be so for the present," Jesus answered, "since it is fitting for us thus to satisfy every claim of religion." Upon this, John consented.

entries.title: Matthew 3:16
segments: After the baptism of Jesus, and just as he came up from the water, the heavens opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending, like a dove, and alighting upon him,

entries.title: Matthew 3:17
segments: And from the heavens there came a voice which said: "This is my son, the Beloved, in whom I delight."
